user.description: Connect to the Android SMS Gateway app running in Local Server mode.

init.description: Controls the system:ping-driven device health monitoring (Online/Battery entities). Sending SMS is unaffected by these options.

data_description.url_mode: internal: the direct LAN address (default, works for most installs). external: the public URL — only if the device can't reach Home Assistant's internal address. auto: internal if configured, else external. This choice isn't verified — an unreachable or auth-gated external URL will register successfully and then silently never deliver.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send a text message via the Android SMS Gateway app.

phone_number.name: Phone number
phone_number.description: Recipient phone number, in E.164 format.
